caption:
A low-angle view captures a grassy field bordered by a dark tree line under a pale sky. A large, intensely bright fireball already dominates the left half of the frame, its saturated white-yellow core near the ground and flooding the foreground grass with an orange glow. The mass is large and luminous from the first frame, and the surrounding trees remain fixed in place.
Over the sequence the bright core climbs, its smooth blob breaking into turbulent yellow and orange lobes that spread toward the upper-left edge. A glowing column of orange light and haze develops beneath the rising mass, linking it to a bright patch at ground level. The flame surface churns, darker red pockets forming along the right flank. As the white heart lifts away, the foreground lighting deepens from washed-out yellow-green to a richer red-orange, and the tree line darkens. The top of the fireball drifts partly out of the upper frame while the stem stays visible below. The background tree line and sky remain largely fixed, consistent with the rising fireball.
